lanes.summary: Confirmed official label Rya åsar - Karlsaflogarna, 19 km, 6 h, Svår/Röd-krävande, 182 m height difference, 55% asphalt/gravel and 45% tractor road/path, official PDFs/maps, facilities and Rya åsar rules/currentness.

Audited Naturkartan GPX/API, Västsverige Google My Maps KML and OSM relation 4177360. Naturkartan/KML are primary A- geometry, 18.947 km, continuous and direction-correct; OSM is connected but reversed, longer and endpoint-divergent.

Found strong facility clusters at Rya åsar, Borås Camping, Björbostugan/Björbo hage, Kypesjön/Kypegården, Ymergården and Karlsaflogarna. Kept several official POIs/fires/rest areas pending due missing coordinates.
Identified Rya åsar/Björbostugan/Ekerydavägen start access and Karlsaflogarna Häljaredsvägen/Toarp kyrka/Dalsjöforsmotet end access, with Västtrafik line 19, 157, 200 and service caveats.
Found recent AllTrails activity through 2026-04-25 but little text, plus Wikiloc, Trailforks, Utsidan and older blogs noting signage, reroute-map mismatch, Kypesjön shelter and mixed/wet terrain.

Confirmed Rya åsar reserve rules at the start, no confirmed Karlsaflogarna reserve, fire-ban authority/status, dogs/livestock/farmland/private-land rules, water caution and no section-specific closure found.

importReadiness.summary: Section 5 has enough official source, GPX/KML/OSM geometry, commute/access, facilities, rules and field-report evidence for a normalization pass. It is not ready for direct runtime import because endpoint semantics, QA/currentness contradiction, several official POI/facility coordinates, Kype-area deduplication, Karlsaflogarna overnight status and water reliability remain unresolved.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 5 is a longer and demanding stage from Rya åsar to Karlsaflogarna. It descends from the Rya åsar/Borås access area through an urban-service corridor near Borås Camping and Knalleland, passes Kypesjön and Kypegården, continues through forest and agricultural landscapes, and ends near the ponds at Karlsaflogarna north of Dalsjöfors. The route has substantial asphalt/gravel-road content and useful services early in the stage, but reliable potable water was not confirmed. The strongest facility clusters are Borås Camping, Kypesjön/Kypegården, Ymergården and Karlsaflogarna shelter/firepit.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 5 GPX as primary geometry, with Västsverige Google My Maps KML as supporting official-linked geometry after stitching. Use OSM relation 4177360 only as a cross-check after reversing and preserving endpoint/divergence notes.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use Naturkartan GPX endpoints for route continuity. Model Rya åsar/Björbobacken/Björbostugan and Karlsaflogarna/Häljaredsvägen/Toarp kyrka as access/facility clusters rather than replacing the line endpoints.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Import Borås Camping as paid lodging/camping/service with customer-utility caveats.
Import Kypesjön/Kypegården as a facility cluster with swimming, seasonal toilets/cafe, shelter/fireplace and parking, while deduplicating nearby grill objects.
Import Ymergården as conditional service/rest/fireplace metadata, with water/toilet/cafe claims opening-hour dependent.
Import Karlsaflogarna / Toarps vindskydd and firepit as shelter/rest/fireplace, but avoid overnight-shelter claim until verified.
Keep Åland/Sjöbo grill, Sjöbovallen/Rydastrand grill, Gullkällan, Femstenarör and official heritage POIs pending until coordinates are verified.
Keep Knalleland, Sjöbo services, Dalsjöfors services and Kransmossen access as nearby access/service metadata or suppress depending import scope.
majorCaveats: Naturkartan/STF QA and reroute warnings conflict with Västsverige stage 3-7 quality-assured statement.

No confirmed potable water source found.

Line 157 at Karlsaflogarna can be limited/preordered.
